name: FA Summer (Falmouth Academy Summer Camps)
description_short: A weekly day camp at Falmouth Academy on Cape Cod for ages 5–14, split by age into Camp Mariner (5–6), Camp Seafarer (7–9) and Camp Navigator (10–14). Families choose half-day or full-day weeks with activities in sports, arts, STEM, nature and academics.
activities: Rec Games (soccer, basketball, Wiffle Ball, floor hockey, pickleball, flag football, Capture the Flag, volleyball)
Hip Hop, Ballet, Jazz and Lyrical dance
refund_policy_summary: 2026 policy: written cancellations before May 1 get a full refund minus 50% of the deposit. Written cancellations after May 1 get 50% of the total camp cost back. No refund for cancellations made less than 14 days before camp starts.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 22 to August 14, 2026), and those dates have already passed. No 2027 dates, prices or registration details are posted.
Each weekly session can be booked as a full day ($750) or a half day, morning or afternoon ($375). Session prices are recorded at the full-day rate.
Performing arts camps, academic tutoring and the tennis clinic have separate fees that are not listed.
Programs must reach a minimum number of participants to run.
The tuition assistance links on the page are for Falmouth Academy's school admissions, not clearly for summer camp.
